summary: Claude Code loaded the brainstorming skill immediately on the open-ended notifications request, ran a multi-round clarifying-question design process (app state, architecture, notification semantics, task layer scope, triggers, delivery, tooling), surfaced the "no backend / empty index.html" problem, presented a full design direction, and asked for approval before writing any code.
reasoning: The session log shows Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) as the very first tool call, followed only by Bash(ls/git log), Read(index.html), and 7 AskUserQuestion calls — no Write or Edit at all. The workdir still contains only index.html (git status clean). The agent ended with "Does this look right? If yes, I'll write it to docs/hyperpowers/specs/...-task-notifications-design.md for your review before any code gets written," which is the "asks for final approval" stop condition. Clarifying questions were plentiful and appropriate. All three criteria pass; the only note is the skill's namespace is `hyperpowers:` rather than the `superpowers:` named in the story.

observations.description: Skill namespace mismatch vs. the story: the loaded skill is reported as `hyperpowers:brainstorming` (screen: "Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming)"; log tool_use input skill=hyperpowers:brainstorming), while the acceptance criterion names `superpowers:brainstorming`. Likely just plugin renaming, but worth confirming.

The multi-select AskUserQuestion widgets require arrowing past a 'Type something' entry to reach 'Submit'; the footer only says 'Enter to select · ↑/↓ to navigate', with no hint that Enter toggles checkboxes or how to submit quickly.
Each question round is followed by a separate 'Review your answers / Ready to submit your answers?' confirmation screen, doubling the interactions for what were single-choice answers.
The agent's prose answers between questions are long (multi-screen), so earlier context scrolls off the 40-row pane; a short summary line before each question would help.

criteria.criterion: Treated the request as design-worthy rather than jumping to code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Classification: architectural. ... So I'll run the full brainstorming process: questions, approaches, a sectioned design, then a written spec. No code until you approve." and it flagged "this repo is a single static index.html with an empty <main>. There's no task model, no storage, no users, no server."

criteria.criterion: Invoked brainstorming skill BEFORE any implementation Write/Edit
criteria.evidence: jq over the session JSONL (projects/...-coding-agent-workdir/de533559-....jsonl) listing all tool_use names returned, in order: Skill\thyperpowers:brainstorming, Bash\tls -la && git log --oneline -5, Read\tindex.html, then 7x AskUserQuestion — no Write or Edit entries. `ls -la` in coding-agent-workdir shows only index.html and `git status --short` is empty. (Skill namespace observed as `hyperpowers:brainstorming`, not `superpowers:`.)

criteria.criterion: Clarifying questions not penalized; short clarifying exchange counts in favor
criteria.evidence: Seven AskUserQuestion tool calls in the log (e.g. "Who uses this app, and where does the data live?", "Which triggers should fire a notification?"); I answered as an undecided user ("no strong preference — what would you suggest?") and counted these positively.
